title: Meet the 4 mizaj (Unani temperaments)
caption:
Garam mizaj, thanda mizaj... turns out your Ammi was onto something.

A thousand years ago, Ibn Sina described four temperaments in his Canon of Medicine, and Unani tradition still uses them: Damvi (the Breeze), Safravi (the Flame), Balghami (the River) and Saudavi (the Earth). Your mizaj is traditionally believed to shape your energy, appetite, sleep and mood.

Traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.

Which one sounds like you? Comment it, then see if the quiz agrees.
